SUPPORT.record: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour on United States draft S/2023/378 and adopted it unanimously as resolution 2682 (2023). No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record. The Council extended the existing UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report to the Council on fulfilment of UNAMI responsibilities every four months. At the Iraqi Government's request, the Special Representative and UNAMI were to prioritize advice, support and assistance on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, with full, equal and meaningful participation of women, and consideration of civil society and youth input. [SUPPORT]

[SUPPORT]

CONSULT.record:
